text: Risk management is the process of identifying possible problems before they happen. First, you need to find the risks that could affect your project, such as delays, budget cuts, or technical issues. After that, you develop mitigation strategies to reduce the chance or impact of these risks. For example, you might train staff or buy extra equipment. It is also wise to create contingency plans, which are backup actions if the worst happens. Finally, you must keep monitoring the situation, because new risks can appear at any time. Good risk management helps you stay calm and prepared.
